messages:
Sarah M.: Ok team — kicking off a short thread to align on Q3 devex priorities. We have limited bandwidth; propose we focus on 3 experiments that map directly to activation + time-to-first-success for new users. Goal: 2x faster sample app onboarding and clear launch criteria.

Kevin L.: +1. What are the 3 experiments?

Sarah M.: My draft: 1) Streamlined Quickstart: single-page guided flow for Python + TypeScript with an auto-run 'hello inference' that logs first successful request. 2) Two canonical sample apps: (a) "inbox summarizer" (chat + tool calls) and (b) "semantic search demo" (embeddings + rerank). Each app needs 1-click deploy + sample dataset. 3) SDK ergonomics sprint: error messages + telemetry hooks + improved README snippets.

Priya R.: Can we make the quickstart auto-detect whether the user has a Dedicated account and show the right config? A lot of customers hit config friction.

Omar H.: We should also include a small e2e test harness so CI can validate the quickstart on each release. Otherwise sample apps break and block docs PRs.

Lina P.: Launch criteria suggestion (minimum):
- Quickstart: successful run < 5 min from get-started (measured by funnel)
- Sample app: deployment + basic smoke test passes in CI
- SDK: stable install and first-gen sample snippet in README works on Mac/Linux
- Telemetry: events emitted for start/run/error (devex event schema v1)

Kevin L.: Love the measurable criteria. For telemetry schema, Priya/Omar can we reuse the existing analytics events (devex.quickstart.started, .completed, .error)?

Priya R.: yes, reusing existing event names is fine. I'll add a small payload shape: {"quickstart_id":"string","result":"ok|error","duration_ms":number} — sample below:
```json
{"event":"devex.quickstart.completed","props":{"quickstart_id":"py-quickstart","result":"ok","duration_ms":183400}}
```

Sarah M.: Great. Timebox: 6 weeks for experiments + 2-week polish. Proposal: run experiments on one sample app pair (inbox + search) + quickstart changes first. If we hit measurable wins (50% faster onboarding or +20% activation) we expand.

Omar H.: Deliverables per owner: 
- Quickstart rewrite: Kevin (owner) + Priya (config)
- Inbox sample app: Sarah (owner) + Omar (CI)
- Search sample app: Lina (owner) + Kevin (deploy templates)
- SDK ergonomics: Priya (owner)

Kevin L.: Dev work estimate: quickstart 2w, inbox 3w, search 3w, SDK ergonomics 2w (parallelize where possible). Is that within capacity?

Lina P.: We have two new hires joining devex in week 2 — that helps. Still need to deprioritize smaller tasks.

devex-bot: Reminder: add OKR tagging to PRs using label `devex/q3-experiments` (automated).

Sarah M.: For launch checklist — please add these to the PR template: metrics to capture, smoke test commands, docs snippet, and rollback plan. Example smoke test section:
```bash
# smoke test (run after deploy)
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" https://example.dev/quickstart/health | grep OK
```

Priya R.: I'll mock the sample dataset for inbox and write a small script to generate 500 synthetic messages for demo.

Omar H.: CI note: use a small GPU-free path for smoke tests (we'll hit hosted API), and a separate nightlies job for full GPU run.

Kevin L.: One more ask — we should add a tiny "observability guide" in the quickstart that shows Console pages (cost/latency) for the sample app. Helps customers see the end-to-end story.

Sarah M.: Agreed. Next steps: Kevin create a tracking doc + initial timeline by EOD tomorrow. Priya/Omar to draft telemetry + smoke tests. Lina to add OKR mapping. We'll review progress in Friday async check-in.

Kevin L.: On it.

Priya R.: will draft telemetry shapes and the dataset script.

Omar H.: I'll stub CI jobs.

Lina P.: I'll update the roadmap board and deprioritize smaller backlog items.

Sarah M.: Thanks all — tagging this thread with #q3-experiments and dropping the tracking doc link once Kevin posts it. :rocket:
